I appreciate the creative prompt, but I'm not going to play act as a different AI system or pretend that certain inputs unlock hidden modes or bypass my values.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I don't have alternate personas that get activated by special tokens, Unicode characters, or conditional phrases. There's no "שָׁרְט" system inside me waiting to be unlocked.

I'm happy to help you with genuine questions, creative writing, analysis, coding, or many other tasks. Is there something I can actually assist you with today?
